# exec reruns when a file its inputs match changes, appears or disappears,
# and passes the changed files in BIT_CHANGED_FILES. Other files don't count.
bit
stdout '^gen ▶ '
stdout '^gen │ changed=unset$'
grep '\Aa\nb\ni\n\z' all.txt

bit
stdout '^gen · no changes$'

# Files outside the globs are not inputs.
cp new.txt src/notes.md
cp new.txt unrelated.txt
bit
stdout '^gen · no changes$'

# Each changed input is listed, one absolute path per line.
cp new.txt src/a.txt
cp new.txt assets/img/i.png
bit
stdout '^gen ▶ .*changed\)$'
stdout '^gen │ changed=\S*/assets/img/i\.png$'
stdout '^gen │ \S*/src/a\.txt$'
! stdout 'b\.txt'
grep '\Anew\nb\nnew\n\z' all.txt

# A new file matching a glob is an input.
cp new.txt src/c.txt
bit
stdout '''src/c\.txt'' \(new\) changed'
stdout '^gen │ changed=\S*/src/c\.txt$'

# Removing it returns to inputs built before, so the shared cache restores
# that result.
rm src/c.txt
bit
stdout '^gen ⇣ .*\(cached\)$'
stdout '^gen │ restore all\.txt$'
grep '\Anew\nb\nnew\n\z' all.txt

# Changing the command plans an update, which runs it in full.
cp BUILD.bit.changed BUILD.bit
bit --plan
stdout '^gen ~ '
bit
stdout '^gen │ changed=unset$'

-- BUILD.bit --
gen = exec {
  command = "echo \"changed=${BIT_CHANGED_FILES-unset}\"; cat src/*.txt assets/img/* > all.txt"
  inputs = ["src/*.txt", "assets"]
  outputs = "all.txt"
}
-- BUILD.bit.changed --
gen = exec {
  command = "echo \"changed=${BIT_CHANGED_FILES-unset}\"; cat src/*.txt assets/img/* > all.txt; true"
  inputs = ["src/*.txt", "assets"]
  outputs = "all.txt"
}
-- src/a.txt --
a
-- src/b.txt --
b
-- assets/img/i.png --
i
-- new.txt --
new
